title: Rotational Kinetic Energy of a Rigid Body

variables.I: Moment of inertia about the axis of rotation
variables.\\omega: Angular velocity of the rigid body

assumptions: Rigid body rotating about a fixed axis or about a principal axis passing through center of mass
Uniform angular velocity omega for all constituent mass elements
validity_conditions: Universal relation for rigid body rotation in classical mechanics
common_misuse: Using moment of inertia about center of mass when body rotates about a different off-center fixed pivot
Adding 1/2 M v_cm^2 when calculating pure rotation about a fixed pivot
